title: Padded clone optimum
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with template $\Psi$ and variables $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement. Suppose the domain $D$ is finite and nonempty, the variable type $V$ is finite, and every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. The padded clone optimum is the padded clone value of the optimal assignment to $V\times\mathrm{Fin}(M)$.
